greet.text: Four coppers a cart. Says so on the board.

choices.text: The board in the square says two.
Ama's coppers come back, I hear.

dace_two.text: "Board's old. Rates went up." He doesn't look at you.

choices.text: Rates went up when you got greedy. Stop, or the captain hears about it.
Here. Take this, and charge the farmers two.

dace_folds.text: "Two coppers. Fine. Two." He spits. "Don't come through my gate after dark."

dace_laughs.text: "The captain?" He laughs. "Prove it." (Somewhere there's a ledger. The toll-fort strongbox, maybe.)

dace_bribed.text: The coins vanish. "Two coppers it is. For a while."

dace_sour.text: "Coppers, coppers. You'd think the river ran on them."
